comments.author: Feier
comments.body_html:
I figured this out and made an account to share with others that might have the issue. This is due to the depth buffer being inverted. Open your Reshade menu, and click “Edit global preprocessor definitions”. Then change “RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_UPSIDE_DOWN” to value 1.

Hope this helps.

https://imgur.com/a/GYXXdsK
